{{Quote|The most powerful long-range unit you can build at your fortress is a blaster cannon.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=BlasterCannon.flac|<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Decimatorcannon.jpg|thumb|250px|A Decimator cannon]]
The '''Decimator cannon''' was a deployable heavy weapon employed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Its all-terrain [[Tread/Legends|treads]] could transform into firm stabilizing feet. During the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]],<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] informed his Wookiee allies that they could construct Decimator cannons at their newly built [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]].<ref name="GB" />
